overview: White plays a delayed King's Gambit after Black's quiet 2...d6. Black can take on f4, sometimes with a g5 push, or hold the centre with ...Nf6 or ...Nc6. White aims for the open f-file and quick development, while Black's d6 pawn gives a solid base. I am unsure of the details, so I describe it as a fairly rare, King's Gambit-style gambit.

white_ideas.idea: Play f4 to open the f-file and push d4, developing quickly with Nf3 and Bc4.
Use the extra central space and lead in development after exf4.

black_ideas.idea: Take on f4 and keep the pawn with ...g5 or ...Nf6, or decline with ...Nf6 and ...Nc6.
Use ...d6 as a solid base and counterattack in the centre.

typical_structures.structure: King's Gambit-like open f-file with White's e4/d4 centre.

character.notes: A gambit with open lines and kingside exposure for both sides.

gambit.notes: If Black takes exf4 the pawn can be kept in many lines.

soundness.notes: Probably playable but rare; the quiet ...d6 helps Black.

plans.reason: White opens the f-file and develops quickly.
